interpretation.binding_vs_retention: The association axis established a binding/interference weakness for both models; this distance axis adds evidence of a stronger long-range retention or state-utilization weakness in the present A1 implementation.
interpretation.distance_axis: A0 held-out exact match and target loss remain broadly flat across distances 4, 16, and 64, while A1 held-out exact match falls to zero and target loss worsens as distance increases.
interpretation.next_axis: Keep the A0/A1 architecture frozen and proceed to the predeclared target-length axis or non-invasive A1 state/decay forensics; defer relational curriculum and A2 until this baseline is recorded.
interpretation.scope: This is one seed and one model size. It does not identify the internal mechanism or authorize an A1 architectural change.
interpretation.token_budget_limitation: Distance rungs use the same optimizer-step budget but longer sequences and therefore more token positions; they are matched-step retention probes, not equal-token comparisons.
interpretation.training_memorization: Both architectures reached 100% autoregressive greedy exact match on the repeated training set at every distance rung.
